title: La avenida llena · de noche
description: How full the Meridiana is at night (docs/chapter-2.md § Night and the way home, `postGroups` in src/night-pupils.ts): when night falls a group of pupils is out already every so many cells of the avenue, on both pavements and the median, each pupil on its own wide round; more climb out of the grates by the party and with each train. Gerard is stood along the way home, on the nearest cell with nobody within six, and each shot taken a second later, to see who is about at each stretch.

steps.eval: window.stand = (x, z) => { const g = window.gerard.game, s = g.nightStreet, open = (cx, cz) => { const row = s.grid[cz]; return !!row && cx >= 0 && cx < row.length && row[cx] !== '#'; }; let best = null; for (let r = 0; r <= 8 && !best; r++) for (let dz = -r; dz <= r && !best; dz++) for (let dx = -r; dx <= r && !best; dx++) { if (Math.max(Math.abs(dx), Math.abs(dz)) !== r) continue; const cx = x + dx, cz = z + dz; if (open(cx, cz) && s.pupils.every(p => Math.hypot(p.position.x - cx, p.position.z - cz) >= 6)) best = { x: cx, z: cz }; } g.standAt(best || { x, z }); }
